groups.quote: In the trail-making test, the completion time for young subjects was 27.4±7.2 s and that for old subjects was 42.5 ±6.9 s; the difference was statistically significant (t(22)=5.25; P<0.001).
groups.notes: The text does not label the ± value for the trail-making test; the only place these pages identify a dispersion is the Fig. 1 caption for pointing errors ("Also shown are the standard deviations"), which concerns a different measure, so dispersion_type is left UNKNOWN. Group size for this test is not restated on this page; the accompanying test is reported as t(22)=5.25.
